## ✨ Why Easily Skills

- **Battle-tested, not toy demos** — every skill comes from daily work: shipping code, writing reports, producing content.
- **Standard `SKILL.md` format** — works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and any agent that loads Agent Skills.
- **Evidence over improvisation** — skills are written to cite sources, flag assumptions and never fabricate facts.
- **Scripts when it matters** — skills marked ⚙️ ship runnable scripts for deterministic work; 📝 skills are pure prompting.

## 🚀 Quick Start

**Option 1 — with the [`skills`](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills) CLI (recommended)**

```bash
# pick skills interactively
npx skills add patrickleehua/easily-skills

# or install just one
npx skills add patrickleehua/easily-skills --skill awesome-report
```

**Option 2 — manual copy**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/patrickleehua/easily-skills.git

# Claude Code: user-level (all projects) or project-level
cp -r easily-skills/awesome-report ~/.claude/skills/
cp -r easily-skills/awesome-report .claude/skills/
```

For other agents, copy the folder into their skills directory. Then just describe your task — the agent picks the right skill from its `description`.

**Skills with ⚙️ / 🔑** need [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) and, if applicable, an API key:

```bash
cd ~/.claude/skills/minimax-api-tools
cp .env.example .env   # fill in your key
uv sync                # only if the skill has a pyproject.toml
```

## 🧱 Anatomy of a Skill

```text
my-skill/
├── SKILL.md        # required: frontmatter (name, description) + instructions
├── references/     # optional: docs loaded on demand
├── scripts/        # optional: executable helpers (⚙️)
├── assets/         # optional: templates, examples, styles
└── .env.example    # optional: required keys (🔑)
```

## 🔄 Adding a Skill — the Catalog Updates Itself

The catalog above is **generated**, not hand-maintained:

1. Add a folder with a `SKILL.md` and push.
2. GitHub Actions runs [`scripts/sync_readme.py`](./scripts/sync_readme.py), classifies the new skill and commits the updated READMEs.
3. *(Optional)* For a precise category and polished bilingual summary, add an entry to [`catalog.yml`](./catalog.yml).

Classification is rule-based — no AI required: `catalog.yml` entry → `category` in `SKILL.md` → keyword match → *Others*.
Prefer to let AI tidy things up? Ask your agent to *"register the new skills in catalog.yml following AGENTS.md"*.

```bash
uv run scripts/sync_readme.py          # regenerate locally
uv run scripts/sync_readme.py --check  # verify only (used in CI)
```

Optional local hook that syncs on every commit:

```bash
git config core.hooksPath .githooks
```

## 🤝 Contributing

Issues and PRs are welcome. When adding a skill, keep the `description` specific about **when to use** and **when not to use** it — that's what makes agents trigger it correctly.
